title: Battle of Buceo
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Buceo", at revision 1366243583, opens: "The Battle of Buceo was a decisive naval battle which took place on 14–17 May 1814, during the Argentine War of Independence between an Argentine fleet under Irish-born naval commander William Brown and a Spanish fleet under Admiral Sierra off the coast of Montevideo, in today's Uruguay." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2890940, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "naval battle which took place on 14–17 May 1814, during the Argentine War of Independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
